prompt:
Listing Contract Seed

Return application/json: exactly five explicitly fictional property-listing records as a JSON array matching the configured schema. Do not add prose or keys. This is classroom seed data, not real property offers or sponsor endorsements.

Use these invented source notes, filling only schema fields:
1. 101 Imaginary Garden Lane, Demo Grove, CA 90032; price425000;2beds;1.5baths;1100square_feet; parking and garden; fictional sponsor Imaginary Garden Shop.
2. 202 Fictional Terrace, Sample Heights, CA 90031-1234; price610000;3beds;2baths;1650square_feet; balcony and air_conditioning; no sponsors.
3. 303 Make-Believe Court, Demo Grove, CA 90032; price780000;4beds;2.5baths;2200square_feet; pool and garden; fictional sponsor Sample Repair Studio.
4. 404 Invented Studio Walk, Example Harbor, CA 90731; price295000;0beds;1bath;520square_feet; pet_friendly; no sponsors.
5. 505 Placeholder Avenue, Sample Heights, CA 90031; price550000;2beds;2baths;1300square_feet; parking and air_conditioning; no sponsors.

Use valid invented UUIDv4 strings for all property_id and sponsor_id fields. Keep numeric fields numeric and nonnegative; bedroom and area values integers. Use exactly the controlled amenity strings, without duplicates. All names, streets and cities are fictional. Every record must contain property_id, street, city, state, zip_code, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, square_feet, amenities and local_sponsors. Sponsors contain only sponsor_id and name. Use only the supplied notes; do not infer phone numbers, email addresses, or real endorsements.
